capabilities: Transcribe audio recordings into timestamped transcripts
Generate AI summaries with key points, decisions, action items and suggestions
Add links to results in the source note
Re-organize an existing transcript while keeping earlier summaries
Export or share transcript, summary or combined Markdown
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it transcribes and organizes recordings captured elsewhere, such as Obsidian Quick Capture or an exported voice memo.
extras: Audio is sent to the selected transcription provider and transcript text to the selected text provider, so API access may incur charges; files over 100 MB are rejected and long recordings are limited by the device. A migration command moves an older 语音整理 folder to RecordNote, and iPhone acceptance testing of the open-audio-file fix is still pending.
intentEvidence: If upgrading from voice-organizer-local, keep the old plugin files until you have verified
problem: Voice recordings captured in Obsidian or stored in the vault stay as raw audio, with no built-in way to turn them into searchable transcripts and structured notes.

relations.evidence: If upgrading from voice-organizer-local, keep the old plugin files until you have verified that settings and recordings are available

requires.name: AI provider API key (MiniMax, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Claude or custom endpoint)

summary: Transcribes audio recordings in a vault with configurable AI services and produces timestamped transcripts, summaries, action items and Markdown notes.
